# DeckArt

Purpose: assets for manufacturers' business presentations. General-purpose transparent PNG illustrations, white-and-blue 16:9 PNG backgrounds, and editable SVG icons, diagrams, charts and explanation parts. Japanese usage metadata; stable English IDs. Assets: CC0-1.0. Code: MIT.

Repository: https://github.com/sakurai-yoshi/deckart
Pinned raw base: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sakurai-yoshi/deckart/v1.0.0/

## Select and retrieve

1. Read catalog.json under the raw base. Match use_case, message, keywords and kind. One ID is one asset; formats and recolors are not duplicate search results.
2. Check format, mime_type, transparent, width/height, size_bytes, render capabilities and optional placement. PNG dimensions are pixels. SVG dimensions are viewBox units. transparent=true means actual PNG alpha; false means opaque PNG; null means SVG transparency is not classified.
3. Read metadata_path. Check guidance.avoid and reading. For illustrations, placement describes framing, facing and recommended_width_cm; people_count is optional descriptive information. Choose a subject whose facing direction leads toward the slide content. For backgrounds, check canvas and content_areas.
4. Retrieve path from the SAME raw base and write the response bytes with the declared format extension. Verify sha256. PNG paths start with media/; SVG paths start with assets/. Do not turn a PNG into an SVG wrapper or redraw the supplied artwork.
5. Keep the aspect ratio when placing the image. Backgrounds fill a 16:9 slide; other assets fit their intended content area. PNG text and color are fixed. Add presentation text separately.

Example PNG: media/illustration/explaining.png
Example PNG metadata: metadata/illustration/explaining.json
Example background: media/background/cover-prismatic-depth.png
Example SVG: assets/process/approval-return.svg
RAG bulk metadata: catalog.ndjson (one complete asset per line).
Generation prompts live once in sources/; metadata.generation.definition_path points to the declaration list. Select its item by key=id. Prompts describe provenance, not an instruction to regenerate a file during retrieval.

## Local search and export

Python 3.10+ and the repository checkout or unpacked release ZIP are sufficient. No package, account or API key is needed.

Search terms separated by spaces are matched with AND. Start with one or two short purpose words; if no result matches, broaden the terms before changing the requested asset kind.

    python3 scripts/library.py search '説明' --format png
    python3 scripts/library.py search '情報' --kind illustration
    python3 scripts/library.py search '承認 差戻し' --themeable --limit 3
    python3 scripts/library.py show illustration/explaining
    python3 scripts/library.py export illustration/explaining --output ./exports/explaining.png
    python3 scripts/library.py export background/cover-prismatic-depth --output ./exports/cover.png
    python3 scripts/library.py export icon/person --accent '#005BAC' --output ./exports/person.svg
    python3 scripts/library.py export --request examples/progress-data.json --output ./exports/progress.svg

search/show/export return UTF-8 JSON. Errors return JSON on stderr and exit code 2. Export writes an image plus JSON sidecar recording source ID, version, original raw_base, path and SHA-256. In exported sidecars, generation.definition_path and preview_path resolve against source.raw_base. The result uses file, format, mime_type, metadata, sha256 and render. --stdout emits only the image bytes. Existing files require --force.

## Capabilities

request.schema.json defines id (required), optional format (must match the asset), accent, monochrome, labels, include_example_labels and data. Read metadata.render before adapting an asset.

- PNG: exact-byte copy with original alpha. No recolor, labels, data, monochrome or format conversion. These options are errors even if empty or false; omit them. Theme is null in the export result.
- SVG theme: default blue, arbitrary #RRGGBB accent or monochrome. Semantic signal colors remain distinct. Pale brand colors are adjusted for contrast; resolved colors and adjustments are returned. themes.json describes paint roles.
- SVG labels: metadata.labels provides label-N IDs, boxes, font size and limits. Supply labels as {"label-1":"申請","label-2":"確認"}. Overflow is an error. Optional SVG text needs the listed system fonts; geometry-only SVG has no font dependency. Editable presentation text can use the same boxes separately.
- SVG charts: catalog values are explicitly sample data. Read metadata.data_input before supplying data. Export recalculates geometry and numeric labels together. Actual supplied values are marked is_sample=false, without claiming data-source verification.
- PNG backgrounds: canvas is the logical design coordinate system, independent of actual pixels. Scale x, y, width and height in content_areas by slide_width/canvas.width and slide_height/canvas.height. The regions specify where to put editable text or supplied charts; they are not raster labels.
- PNG illustrations: placement describes the artwork rather than restricting the business scenario. Reuse a general action for any matching use_case, but do not infer actual certification, measured performance or a named company from the drawing.

Search paths and hashes refer to original assets. Keep lookup, metadata and downloaded bytes pinned to the same tag or commit. Never silently substitute a different format or an invented local filename extension.
